spec.description: What the providers answer, how long delivery takes, and what waits to be retried.

Every reply other than accepted, per minute, sorted by reason: slowed down (rate_limited), blocked (reputation_block), failed checks (auth_failure), unknown address (invalid_recipient), full mailbox, busy, and others. The Reply codes dashboard explains each code.
spec.subtitle: Replies other than accepted, by reason
spec.title: Why emails were not delivered

spec.description: Connections opened per minute, by TLS version and certificate check. none means the email went unencrypted. Gmail asks for TLS and shows an encryption rate in Postmaster Tools.
spec.subtitle: By TLS version; none means unencrypted
spec.title: Encrypted connections

spec.description: Seconds from entering the queue to the provider accepting the email. typical: half the emails were faster. slowest 5%: 95 of every 100 were faster. A provider whose slow line climbs alone is deferring mail.
spec.subtitle: Typical and slowest 5%, queue to accepted
spec.title: Time to deliver, by provider

spec.description: Share of attempts the provider answered with "slow down": Gmail 421 4.7.28, Microsoft 451 4.7.650 and RP-001, Yahoo TSS04. At the line, 5%, ehlo stops the server toward that provider for 10 minutes.
spec.subtitle: At the line, 5%, ehlo pauses for 10 minutes
spec.title: Slowed down by providers

spec.description: Share of attempts that failed before the provider accepted a conversation: connection refused or timed out, greeting refused, or TLS failed. Every server failing points at the provider or the network; one server failing points at its IP, reverse DNS or TLS.
spec.subtitle: Attempts that never reached a conversation
spec.title: Failed connections
